requirements.text: Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a comparable field
At least 3 years of relevant professional experience covering accounting and controlling
Independently manage timely monthly and annual closings
Knowledge of VAT and recurring tax filings
Experience coordinating audits and external tax advisors
Ability to independently own finance processes from transaction-level detail through to management-level analysis
Management accounts, variance analysis, cost-centre reporting and KPIs
Fluent in English and at least basic skills in German
Experience in a fast-growing, project-driven or international environment

resumes.text:
Markus Feld
Munich, Germany

Summary
Finance professional with seven years of accounting and controlling experience in growing, international companies. Known for reliable closings, clear management reporting and smooth work with auditors and tax advisors. Comfortable owning a finance process from the first booking to the board pack.

Experience

Senior Accountant, Brightwell Logistics GmbH, Munich (March 2021 - present)
- Own accounts payable, accounts receivable and bank reconciliations for three group entities.
- Run the month-end routine for the group and finish every close by working day five.
- Prepare the statutory annual accounts under HGB and handle every request from the external audit firm each spring.
- Manage the VAT return cycle and the recurring tax filings with our outside tax consultancy.
- Take transactions from first posting all the way to the management pack, so the controlling team needs no rework.
- Prepare monthly management reports, variance commentary and cost-centre analyses for department heads.
- Daily user of SAP ECC 6.0 for postings, controlling and reporting.
- Helped the company grow from 40 to 200 staff across Germany, Austria and Poland, extending the close process to each new entity.

Accountant, Ostwind Retail AG, Hamburg (June 2018 - February 2021)
- Handled the fixed asset register, accruals and provisions for a 12-store retail group.
- Supported the annual budget and quarterly forecasts with the controlling team.
- Reconciled intercompany accounts across two legal entities.

Education
Bachelor of Science in Business Administration, University of Hamburg, 2018

Skills
- HGB reporting and balance-sheet work
- VAT and recurring tax filings
- SAP ECC 6.0 (FI and CO)
- Excel and Power BI
- Languages: English (fluent), German (B1)

Julia Brandt
Berlin, Germany

Summary
Accounting and controlling specialist with three years of experience at a mid-sized engineering firm. Careful with detail, reliable with deadlines, and happy to take on new responsibilities.

Experience

Accounting and Controlling Specialist, Kestrel Engineering GmbH, Stuttgart (January 2022 - present)
- Own the posting cycle for two entities, from supplier invoices to the finished ledger.
- Close the books each month for both entities and prepare the year-end files that our auditors request.
- Maintain the fixed asset register and the depreciation schedules.
- Work in the company's Microsoft Dynamics NAV system daily for bookings and reporting.
- Keep the Austrian GAAP (UGB) reporting for the group's subsidiary in Linz up to date.
- Organise supplier documents so that the audit trail stays complete.

Junior Accountant, Rheinwerk Services AG, Cologne (September 2019 - December 2021)
- Processed accounts payable and receivable for a services company with 150 staff.
- Assisted with bank reconciliations and payroll journals.
- Supported the quarterly closing checklist.
- Learned the monthly routine from a senior controller and took over the petty cash process after one year.

Projects
- Led a small project to move the fixed asset register from spreadsheets into the ERP. It took four months and was finished on time.
- Wrote a one-page guide to the new expense policy for colleagues and ran a short training session for the sales team.

Education
Diploma in Business Administration, University of Cologne, 2019

Skills
- Microsoft Dynamics NAV
- Austrian GAAP (UGB) reporting
- Excel (advanced)
- Languages: English (fluent), French (conversational)

Interests
Running, chess, and volunteering at a local food bank.

Daniel Roth
Munich, Germany

Summary
Hospitality manager with six years of experience running a busy restaurant and cafe. Strong in team leadership, guest service and keeping a tight schedule. Looking for a new direction where I can use my organisation skills.

Experience

General Manager, Kaffeehaus Lindenhof, Munich (2019 - present)
- Lead a team of 18 staff across two shifts and manage the weekly rota.
- Order supplies from local producers and agree delivery times with suppliers.
- Plan seasonal menus and track food waste to keep costs under control.
- Organise private events, weddings and corporate lunches for up to 120 guests.
- Use QuickBooks for the cafe's invoices and supplier payments.
- Coordinate the cleaning, maintenance and opening checklists with the kitchen team.

Shift Supervisor, Trattoria Sole, Augsburg (2016 - 2019)
- Supervised front-of-house operations during dinner service.
- Trained new hires on the point-of-sale system and the guest service standards.
- Handled complaints and turned difficult guests into regulars.

Achievements
- Won the regional hospitality award for guest service in 2021.
- Opened the dining room of a second site in 2022 and recruited its full team of 12.

Certificates
- Food hygiene certificate (HACCP).

Education
Bachelor of Science in Business Administration, Technische Hochschule Augsburg, 2016
Thesis: customer loyalty in small restaurants.

Skills
- Team leadership and staff scheduling
- Event planning and menu design
- Microsoft Office (Word and Excel)
- QuickBooks (small business edition)
- Languages: German (native), English (fluent)

Interests
Cooking classes, cycling and hosting community dinners.
